summary: The archive combines Labour early sex-region-only middle (nodes 9:25) with all-intermediate middle (nodes 1:25) elsewhere. Raw-array recomputation resolves the competing numerical inputs under the all-intermediate definition.

details.scope: Only the 12 aggregate hierarchical percentages in Supplement S8.4; no manuscript modifications or new experiments.
details.formula: For each of 8 dataset/backbone groups, average the two unrounded window RMSEs for each method and scope; 100*(1-method_group_mean/baseline_group_mean); arithmetic mean of 8 group percentages. Node RMSE=sqrt(mean_72((prediction-truth)^2)); scope RMSE=arithmetic mean of node RMSEs.
details.middle_definition: All observed internal nodes excluding the system root and bottom leaves, one equal weight per node. For Labour this is nodes 1..24: 8 region + 16 sex-region. Archive Labour early is instead 9..24, only 16 sex-region.

claims.full_precision_note: JSON floats and CSV decimals are round-trip representations of IEEE-754 float64; no display rounding was used before group ratios.
claims.paper_text:
Relative to Factor, Cov and ML reduced system RMSE by 4.77\% and 4.58\%,
intermediate-level RMSE by 4.38\% and 4.32\%, and bottom-level RMSE by
5.52\% and 5.51\%. The corresponding reductions relative to Diag were
4.86\% and 4.67\%, 3.95\% and 3.88\%, and 5.02\% and 5.01\%.
Intermediate-level RMSE averages all observed nodes between the system
and bottom levels. In Labour, these are the eight regional and sixteen
sex-by-region series.

limitations: This audit verifies stored predictions and truth arrays and their aggregation; it does not rerun model training or independently authenticate the original observations.

All-intermediate is the definition implemented for the 14 original windows and supported by the summing-matrix geometry; selecting another named level is a reporting choice requiring consistent relabelling, not a numerical truth adjudication.
details.independence: Fresh agent received only paper/evidence paths and a narrow audit task. No prior reports, executor interpretations, or audit conclusions were read.
details.paper_claims_against_raw: All 12 match standard rounding under all-internal-nonroot-node middle; no paper numerical correction is indicated by this audit.
details.natural_language_mapping: Intermediate-level without a named restriction most naturally denotes all non-root, non-leaf internal nodes here, matching the 14 original windows and the summing matrices. Because Labour has both region and sex-region internal levels, an explicit all-intermediate-node definition would remove residual language ambiguity. Sex-region-only is a valid separately named level but is not interchangeable with all intermediate nodes.
details.source_receipt_hash_check: All endpoints/Cov/ML/Diag file SHA256 values for the 14 original windows match streams.csv; Labour early context truth and S exactly match raw.npz.
